Lorville.description: Company city owned and operated by Hurston Dynamics. Teasa Spaceport is the main landing zone. Dark, industrial atmosphere.
Lorville.services: Trade, medical, ship repair, outfitting, armistice zone
Lorville.key_shops: Tammany and Sons (armour), Garrity Defense (weapons), J&J Electronics (components), TDD terminal
Lorville.trade_speciality: Buying: refined metals, electronics. Selling: agricultural goods, processed food
Lorville.coordinates: Hurston, approximately 326 km from planet core

Area18.description: ArcCorp's corporate city planet. Area18 is the primary landing zone — an industrial megacity covering the entire planet surface.
Area18.services: Trade, medical, ship repair, full outfitting
Area18.key_shops: Casaba Outlet (armour/clothing), Voyager Direct (general), Cubby Blast (weapons), TDD terminal

New Babbage.description: Corporate city on the frozen planet microTech. The Aspire Grand and Commons house most shopping and services.
New Babbage.services: Trade, medical, ship repair, full outfitting, weapon modification
New Babbage.key_shops: Centermass (weapons), Omega Pro (components), TDD terminal, armour shops
New Babbage.trade_speciality: Electronics, medical supplies, processed food. Sells: refined ores

Orison.description: Crusader Industries' floating city above the gas giant Crusader. Unique cloud-top environment with multiple platforms.
Orison.services: Trade, medical, ship repair, full outfitting
Orison.key_shops: Voyager Direct, TDD terminal, Crusader Industries store
Orison.trade_speciality: Agricultural goods, diluthermex. Hydrogen nearby in atmosphere

Grim HEX.description: Former mining station turned outlaw hub orbiting Yela. No UEE security presence. Black market and criminal services available.
Grim HEX.services: Basic trade, medical, ship repair, black market, criminal missions
Grim HEX.key_shops: Conscientious Objects (armour/gear), Skutters (ship parts), black market dealer
Grim HEX.trade_speciality: Stims sell well. Illegal goods available. No crime stat enforcement.

Port Tressler.description: Orbital rest stop at microTech's L1 Lagrange point. Full trade and repair services.
Port Tressler.key_shops: TDD terminal, ship components vendor, armistice zone
Port Tressler.trade_speciality: Buy: processed food, medical supplies. Sell: refined ores and metals

Baijini Point.description: ArcCorp L1 orbital rest stop. Heavy trade traffic due to ArcCorp's industrial output.
Baijini Point.trade_speciality: Industrial supplies and electronics readily available here

Everus Harbor.description: Hurston L1 orbital platform. Major hub for mining and industrial goods distribution.
Everus Harbor.key_shops: TDD terminal, ship components, armistice zone
Everus Harbor.trade_speciality: Buy: medical supplies, agricultural goods. Sell: Hurston-produced metals

Levski.description: Anti-UEE political settlement carved into the asteroid Delamar. Premium sell prices for most commodities.
Levski.trade_speciality: High-demand sell point for refined ore and salvage materials in Nyx routes

R&R HUR-L1.description: Hurston L1 rest stop. Basic services, trade, and refuelling.
R&R HUR-L1.trade_speciality: Good buy/sell location for metals and industrial goods

R&R HUR-L2.description: Hurston L2 rest stop. Trade and refuelling services.

R&R HUR-L4.description: Hurston L4 rest stop. One of the best buy locations for Quantanium.
R&R HUR-L4.trade_speciality: Best buy for Quantanium. Also: Laranite buy point

R&R CRU-L3.description: Crusader L3 rest stop. Beryl mining proximity.

R&R CRU-L5.description: Crusader L5 rest stop. Good all-rounder for buying mining ores.
R&R CRU-L5.trade_speciality: Agricium and Corundum buy. Medical supplies sell well

R&R ARC-L1.trade_speciality: Best sell for Agricultural Supplies. Bexalite buy location

R&R MIC-L1.trade_speciality: Electronics and components sell well nearby

Daymar.description: Barren moon orbiting Crusader. Sandy surface, cave systems rich in hand-mining minerals. Notable outposts: Kudre Ore, Shubin Mining SMCa-6/8.
Daymar.services: Mining outpost trade, basic repair at some outposts
Daymar.trade_speciality: Quantanium and Taranite mining. Caves: Hadanite, Aphorite (hand mining)

Cellin.description: Rocky volcanic moon of Crusader. Small outposts. Mining and patrol contracts common.
Cellin.trade_speciality: Rock surface mining. Instability research outposts

Yela.description: Icy moon with an asteroid ring — the Yela Belt. Rich in Quantanium and Bexalite. Home to Grim HEX.
Yela.trade_speciality: Yela Belt: best ship mining zone for Quantanium, Taranite, and Bexalite

Aberdeen.description: Dry, desolate moon of Hurston. Shubin mining facilities operate here. Criminal activity.
Aberdeen.trade_speciality: Gold and Titanium. Shubin Mining Facility SMCa-8

Arial.description: Temperate moon of Hurston with green-blue skies. Some mining facilities.

Lyria.description: Rocky moon of ArcCorp. Humboldt Mines and other facilities operate here. Bexalite and Diamond deposits.
Lyria.trade_speciality: Bexalite and Diamond. Humboldt Mines buy location

Wala.description: Small moon of ArcCorp. Limited outposts. Mostly rock and dust.

Calliope.description: Icy blue moon of microTech. Deep cave systems with hand-mining opportunities.
Calliope.services: Limited outpost services, cave hand mining

Euterpe.description: Smallest microTech moon. Cave systems with Aphorite and Hadanite deposits.

Benson Mining Outpost.description: Small mining outpost on Daymar. Limited trade but a buy point for Quantanium.

Shubin Mining Facility SCD-1.description: Shubin Mining industrial facility. Trades in locally mined ores.

Humboldt Mines.description: Major Bexalite and Diamond mining operation on Lyria.

Ruin Station.description: Primary Pyro system hub station. Outlaw haven with full services but no UEE presence. The meeting point of Pyro factions.
Ruin Station.services: Trade, repair, refuelling, medical, outfitting, black market
Ruin Station.key_shops: Various Pyro vendors, faction mission terminals
Ruin Station.trade_speciality: Pyro system ores, faction gear, illegal goods

Bloom.description: Surface trading settlement on Pyro V. Unique market with Pyro-exclusive goods.
Bloom.trade_speciality: Pyro RGD armour, Pyro-specific weapons and components

Checkmate Station.description: Contested orbital platform near Pyro II. Faction control fluctuates. High combat risk.

Orinth.description: A small habitat and rest stop near the edges of the Pyro system. Minimal services.
Orinth.trade_speciality: Emergency resupply for Pyro deep-space operations

Pyro 4.description: Volatile Pyro world with dangerous weather and strong ore yields. Often treated as a top Pyro mining hotspot.
Pyro 4.trade_speciality: High-risk mining routes with strong upside for organized crews

Nyx Transit Hub.description: Key transit and staging node for Nyx-side operations and route chaining.
Nyx Transit Hub.trade_speciality: Staging point for Delamar and Nyx outer-route logistics

Nyx Outer Belt.description: Sparse but valuable asteroid lanes used for mining and salvage expedition runs.
Nyx Outer Belt.trade_speciality: Expedition mining and salvage opportunities with lower traffic

Aaron Halo (Stanton).description: A dense asteroid ring between Hurston and ArcCorp. Rich in valuable ores. High pirate activity.
Aaron Halo (Stanton).trade_speciality: Excellent ship mining: Quantanium, Taranite, Bexalite, Diamond. Extreme piracy risk.
Aaron Halo (Stanton).coordinates: Stanton inner belt between HUR and ARC

Kudre Ore.description: Mining outpost on Daymar operated by Shubin. Quantanium buy location.
